request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:RAIDER

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: retro 1950s pulp science-fiction invaders, cheerful and toy-like. Their fixed colours: polished chrome and silver-white metal shaded with soft blue-grey, dark gunmetal joints and undersides, rivets and small fins, clear pale glass domes with one white highlight, and exactly one accent colour, a bright glowing hot magenta pink, only as small lights and glows: lamps, lenses, antenna tips, emitter tips.
layers.negative: green skin, green alien, lime, slime, tentacles, blue glow, cyan glow, yellow lights, orange flames, fire, red, gold, brass, brown, wood, leather, rust, purple, violet, medieval, sword, bow, horse, scary, horror, realistic, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute toy-like machine map piece, a single vehicle or device with big simple rounded shapes and one oversized signature feature, thick single-colour black outline; the whole machine is visible, and its lowest part is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Saucer, a small classic 1950s flying saucer, flying: one wide round polished chrome disc seen slightly from above, a row of small round glowing hot magenta running lights around its rim, a clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and the tiny bald lavender-grey head of an alien pilot with big black eyes inside, a dark gunmetal underside with one short round beam emitter glowing hot magenta under its centre; no legs and no landing gear; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a small fast scout ship.
The saucer is drawn large and fills most of the width of the image.
layers.negative: person standing beside it, soldier, wheels, landing legs, tripod
